title: Centrally Located Home in North Nashville
description:
The whole group will enjoy easy access to Broadway, Midtown, The Gulch, Germantown, and East Nashville from this centrally located place.

The space
This is a newly constructed home that was built in 2019 with a spacious open floor plan on the first floor that is great for family and friends to spend quality time together. It contains a full kitchen with an island, dining area, desk, a living area with a TV, a half bathroom, and washer and dryer. Guests can expect to have everything they need to cook family dinners, enjoy a movie or game on TV, or just lounge before heading out to explore all the local attractions Nashville has to offer. Each room on the 2nd floor contains a queen bed with very soft linens and pillows, blackout curtains, a smart TV, and a ceiling fan to ensure everyone gets a great night's rest. The master bedroom has an en suite full bathroom with a huge walk-in shower. The other two bedrooms share a Jack and Jill style bathroom. Each floor of the home has its own thermostat to ensure comfortable temperatures throughout your stay. The backyard is fully fenced in and it has a patio area with furniture to enjoy time outdoors.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the whole home.
